The '''Denbo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home to the [[Viraxo Industries]] installation ''[[Viraxo 54]]''.
